item.title: Identity, Living Fearless book review
item.description:
![[livingfearless.png]]

One book that has made a difference in my life was The Cross and the Switchblade by David Wilkerson. It was amazing to see how the holy spirit guided Wilkerson in his life. From wondering if God wanted him to go to New York City then to the holy spirit leading him to found Times Square Church and Teen Challenge. One Teen Challenge still exist in 2025 in Meskigan Michigan. That’s the part of the Cross and the switchblade I love. That’s how I began coming back to Christ. My life was a mess and I figured if Wilkerson can do it so can I. Find the holy spirit. I’m stubborn most of that has been by fire. I’m still being disciplined it seems.
